blurb: Kayak Cedar Keys offers kayak rentals to explore various unique and beautiful kayaking spots around Cedar Key, including wildlife refuges and state parks. Guests can paddle to islands, observe diverse wildlife, and enjoy both freshwater and saltwater paddling. The area features primitive campsites accessible by kayak for extended trips.
